records.title: History Capstone
records.header: T HIST 498 History Capstone (5) SSc
records.text: T HIST 498 History Capstone (5) SSc Emphasizes analysis of methodological issues and developing students' research and writing skills in history. Includes a significant independent research project planned and carried out by the student to complete senior thesis and portfolio requirements, including the oral presentation. Prerequisite: minimum grade of 2.0 in either T HIST 380 or TIAS 380.
